description: Per-cue voice volume multipliers used by the sound manager and sequencer to adjust individual spoken lines relative to global voice settings.

Id.simple: Voice cue name that this volume override applies to.
Id.technical: FName key. AGameSoundManager looks it up with FName(VoiceRow.CueName) before applying the runtime "_En" localization suffix, so English variants share the base cue volume. The sequencer removes a trailing case-insensitive _En from a cue name before lookup. None IDs are rejected by the shared finder; a missing row defaults to multiplier 1.0. Export spells it ID.

Volume.simple: Multiplier applied to the voice line volume.
Volume.technical: float, constructor default 0.0f, but a missing row is treated as 1.0 by consumers. In PlaySystemVoice and both 2D/3D PlayVoice paths the value is multiplied with VoiceVolume, MasterVolume, VoiceVolumeA/B settings; for example PlayVoice uses ((VoiceVolume*MasterVolume)*(RowVolume*VoiceVolumeB)) regrouped by compiler /fp:fast. The sequencer GetCueVolume returns the raw row value (or 1.0) as its cue volume. Exported values are mostly 1.3-2.0.

notes: Loaded as a DataTable primary asset named VoiceVolumeDataTable into DTM.VoiceVolumeDataTables (+0x7A0).
This table keys on the VoiceDataTable CueName, not VoiceDataTable.Id, and deliberately uses the unsuffixed cue name so localized variants inherit one override.
No row means 1.0f; a row with constructor default 0.0f would silence the cue, so exported rows should be checked rather than assuming absent equals zero.
The companion export contains 1,044 rows; retail completeness and Blueprint-only references are not asserted. Source is reconstructed retail C++ with retail RVAs recorded inline.

usages.detail: Shared typed finder over VoiceVolume tables.
PlaySystemVoice applies the row multiplier to the system voice player.
Sequencer sound module reads per-cue volume with _En stripped.
